description: Original retrieval fixture for M00.03.04 (written for this benchmark; no third-party text). 'Kestrel Labs', its products (Heron, Osprey) and policies are fictional. General-knowledge passages are paraphrased common facts written from scratch. Queries are deliberately paraphrased (low lexical overlap) and the corpus contains near-duplicate distractors on the same topics. Queries tagged lang != 'en' are multilingual.

passages.text: Employees of Kestrel Labs who work remotely at least three days a week receive a home-office stipend of 450 euros per calendar year, paid with the March payroll. Receipts are not required for amounts under 100 euros, but larger purchases such as chairs or monitors must be logged in the expense portal within 30 days.

Business travellers receive a daily meal allowance of 38 euros for domestic trips and 55 euros for international trips. Hotel bookings above 160 euros per night need approval from a department head. Train travel is preferred over flights for any journey shorter than five hours.

Kestrel Labs grants 20 weeks of fully paid leave to the primary caregiver and 8 weeks to the secondary caregiver after the birth or adoption of a child. The leave may be split into at most three blocks and must be used within 18 months.
Staff may self-certify up to three consecutive days of illness. From the fourth day onward a note from a doctor is required. Sick days never reduce the annual vacation balance.

Laptop passwords no longer expire on a fixed schedule. Instead, staff must use a passphrase of at least 14 characters and enrol a hardware security key. Passwords are reset only after a suspected compromise.

The corporate VPN client disconnects after 12 hours of continuous use and then requires re-authentication. Split tunnelling is disabled, so all traffic, including video calls, passes through the Frankfurt gateway.
Engineering file servers are snapshotted every four hours, and the snapshots are retained for 35 days. A full off-site copy is written every Sunday night to a separate region and kept for one year.

A Sev-1 incident is any outage that blocks all customers from signing in or that risks data loss; the on-call engineer must page the incident commander within 10 minutes. Sev-2 covers degraded performance affecting a subset of customers, with a 30-minute response target.

Every pull request that touches authentication, billing or data-retention code needs approval from one reviewer outside the author's immediate team. Other changes need one approval from any engineer. Reviews should be completed within one working day.

The Heron soil sensor measures moisture, temperature and electrical conductivity every 15 minutes. It runs for about 26 months on two AA lithium cells and reports over LoRaWAN with a typical range of 4 km in open farmland.

The Heron gateway collects readings from up to 400 sensors and forwards them to the cloud over Ethernet or LTE. It buffers up to 72 hours of readings locally while the uplink is down and uploads them once the connection returns.
The Osprey wildlife camera records 4K video at 30 frames per second, triggered by a passive infrared detector. Its battery pack lasts roughly 9 weeks at 20 triggers a day.

Hardware bought directly from Kestrel Labs carries a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Water damage is covered only for devices rated IP67 or higher. Units bought through resellers follow the reseller's terms.
Customers can return unused devices within 45 days for a full refund. Devices that have been opened can be returned within 14 days, subject to a 15 percent restocking fee.

In photosynthesis, plants use light energy to turn carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen. The light-dependent reactions take place in the thylakoid membranes, while the Calvin cycle fixes carbon in the stroma of the chloroplast.

Ocean tides are caused mainly by the Moon's gravitational pull, with the Sun adding a smaller effect. When the Sun, Moon and Earth line up, their combined pull produces larger spring tides; when they sit at right angles, smaller neap tides result.

Shield volcanoes are built from runny basaltic lava and have broad, gentle slopes, while stratovolcanoes form from alternating layers of ash and viscous lava, which gives them steep profiles and more explosive eruptions.

A sourdough starter is a culture of wild yeast and lactic acid bacteria kept in flour and water. Feeding it at a 1:1:1 ratio of starter, flour and water by weight twice a day keeps it active at room temperature.

For fluffy long-grain rice, rinse the grains until the water runs clear, use about one and a half parts water to one part rice, simmer covered for 15 minutes, then let it rest off the heat for 10 minutes before lifting the lid.

Expenses up to 500 euros are approved by the employee's direct manager. Amounts between 500 and 5,000 euros also require approval from finance, and anything above 5,000 euros needs sign-off from the chief financial officer.
Supplier invoices are paid on net-45 terms. Every invoice must quote a valid purchase order number; invoices without one are returned to the supplier unpaid.
The Lisbon office is open from 7:00 to 21:00 on weekdays. Visitors must be registered at reception one day in advance, and bicycles can be parked in the basement garage.
The Oslo office closes at 18:00 and stays shut at weekends. The canteen serves lunch between 11:00 and 13:00, and the sauna on the top floor can be booked through the room planner.
Customer support tickets are deleted 24 months after they are closed. Audit logs are kept for 7 years, while application debug logs are kept for only 14 days.
Customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.3. Encryption keys are rotated every 90 days and stored in a hardware security module.

New hires receive their laptop on the first morning and must complete security training within their first five working days. Each newcomer is paired with an onboarding buddy for the first eight weeks.
Performance reviews happen twice a year, in May and in November. Salary adjustments are decided only in the November cycle.
Movable-type printing spread quickly through Europe in the second half of the fifteenth century, lowering the cost of books and helping literacy grow among merchants and craftspeople.
The Danube flows roughly 2,850 kilometres from the Black Forest in Germany to the Black Sea, passing through or along the borders of ten countries, more than any other river in the world.
Adults lose water through breathing, sweat and urine, and their needs rise in hot weather and during exercise. Pale yellow urine is a simple everyday sign of adequate hydration.

Tomato plants need at least six to eight hours of direct sun. Water them deeply at the base two or three times a week rather than lightly every day, which encourages deep roots and reduces leaf disease.

A healthy compost pile balances carbon-rich browns such as dry leaves with nitrogen-rich greens such as vegetable scraps, roughly three parts brown to one part green, and is turned every one to two weeks.
The public Kestrel API allows 600 requests per minute per API token. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header; bulk exports should use the asynchronous export endpoint instead.
API versions are named by release date, for example 2026-03-01. A version stays supported for at least 18 months after its successor is released.
Webhook deliveries are signed with HMAC-SHA256 using the endpoint's secret. Failed deliveries are retried with exponential backoff for up to 24 hours.
Suspicious emails should be reported with the Report Phishing button rather than forwarded to colleagues. The security team aims to triage reports within two hours during business hours.
A lost or stolen laptop must be reported to the IT service desk within one hour of discovery so the device can be remotely locked and wiped.
Kestrel Labs aims to cut its operational emissions by 60 percent by 2030 compared with 2022. All offices switched to renewable electricity contracts in 2025.
Every employee can take two paid volunteering days per year for registered charities. The days must be booked in the HR system at least two weeks ahead.
Each employee has a learning budget of 1,200 euros per year for courses, books and conferences. Unused budget does not roll over into the following year.
A day on Mars, called a sol, lasts about 24 hours and 39 minutes. Mars has two small moons, Phobos and Deimos.
Sound travels at about 343 metres per second in dry air at 20 degrees Celsius, roughly four times slower than it travels in water.
The office espresso machine must be descaled every Friday. Only filtered water from the kitchen tap should be poured into its tank.
Wednesdays are meeting-free for engineering teams. Recurring meetings longer than 30 minutes need a written agenda shared at least a day in advance.
Heron sensors receive firmware updates over the air in small fragments; a complete update takes about three days so that it does not drain the battery.
The Osprey camera stores footage on a microSD card of up to 512 GB and overwrites the oldest clips when the card is full, unless loop recording has been switched off.
Full-time staff receive 27 days of paid vacation per year plus public holidays. Up to five unused days may be carried into the first quarter of the next year.
Conference travel paid from the learning budget still follows the standard travel allowance rules, and speaking at a conference adds one extra paid day for preparation.
Domestic cats sleep around 12 to 16 hours a day and are most active at dawn and dusk.
Honeybees tell their hive mates the direction and distance of a food source by performing a waggle dance on the comb.
